Cub Scout Adult Leader Uniform

# Cub Scout Adult Leader Uniform

## Den Leader and Assistant Den Leader

All Den Leader uniform have the following parts;

1\. Shirt—The official tan uniform shirt is available with long or short
sleeves and has button-flap pockets.  Den leaders wear blue shoulder loops.
The Cub Scout Den Leader position patch is placed on the left sleeve.

2\. Pants— The official green shorts, long pants, skorts, and roll up pants.

3\. Belt—Official green web belt with metal buckle, plain leather belt, or
scout leather belt with scout belt buckle.

4\. Socks—Official green socks are available in three lengths: ankle, crew,
and knee.

5\. Hat—Optional, if an adult chooses they may wear any official BSA adult
hat.

6\. Neckerchief—Optional, Den Leaders may wear any official BSA neckerchief.
They do not wear youth neckerchiefs.

7\. Neckerchief slide—Optional, Den Leaders may use an official BSA slide or
may wear handmade neckerchief slides.

## Cubmaster and Assistant Cubmaster

The Cubmaster uniform has the following parts;

1\. Shirt—The official tan uniform shirt is available with long or short
sleeves and has button-flap pockets.

2\. Pants— The official green shorts, long pants, skorts, or roll up pants.

3\. Belt—Green BSA web belt or any BSA belt with metal buckle.

4\. Socks—Official green socks are available in three lengths: ankle, crew,
and knee.

5\. Hat—Optional, if an adult choose they may wear any official BSA adult hat.

6\. Neckerchief— Optional, Cubmasters may wear any official BSA neckerchief.  

7\. Neckerchief slide—Optional, Cubmasters may use any official BSA slide or
may wear handmade neckerchief slides.



## Pack Committee Chair and Pack Committee Members

**The uniform is optional for Pack Committee Chair and Pack Committee
Members**

1\. Shirt—The official tan uniform shirt is available with long or short
sleeves and has button-flap pockets.

2\. Pants— The official green shorts, long pants, skorts, or roll up pants.

3\. Belt—Green BSA web belt or any BSA belt with metal buckle.

4\. Socks—Official green socks are available in three lengths: ankle, crew,
and knee.

5\. Hat—Optional, if an adult choose they may wear any official BSA adult hat.

6\. Neckerchief— Optional, any official BSA neckerchief.  

7\. Neckerchief slide—Optional, any official BSA slide or may wear handmade
neckerchief slides.
